🚨 CVE-2026-57853 - Docker
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Docker
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 8.8
Resumo:
DataGerry before 3.3.0 contains a server-side template injection vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers with base.docapi.template.add permission to store arbitrary Jinja2 payloads in the template_data field via POST /rest/docapi/template, which is later rendered in a non-sandboxed Jinja2 environment when a user calls GET /rest/docapi/template/ /render/ . Attackers can exploit the standard cycler.__init__._...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-57853
 
🚨 CVE-2026-121966 - Nginx
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Nginx
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 8.7
Resumo:
Traefik 2.x before 2.11.60 and 3.x before 3.7.16 sends ForwardAuth subrequests (and, in 3.7, Ingress NGINX auth-url requests) through an auth-server connection pool shared by all clients, exposing connection-bound NTLM or Negotiate authentication. An unauthenticated attacker can reuse another user's authenticated connection, receiving the victim's identity via authResponseHeaders to access backends as that user.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-121966
 
🚨 CVE-2026-33379 - Grafana
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Grafana
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 8.5
Resumo:
A user with any role, including Viewer or a service account with no permissions, can create, externally publish, and delete dashboard snapshots (missing authorization). Only Grafana OSS and Grafana Enterprise 12.4 are affected; earlier versions and Grafana 13 are not.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-33379

Link: https://blogs.vmware.com/vmware-japan/2026/11/customer-case-studies-mazda.html

🚨 Microsoft Paint RCE Fix Now Available, but Windows Update Won't Deliver It
 
Criticidade: Baixa
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: 1.2
Resumo:
A fix for CVE-2026-83844, a remote code execution flaw in Windows Paint, is now in the Microsoft Store. Paint gets this fix only through a Store update, not through Windows updates. The fixed build, 11.2609.401.0, was the newest Paint build in all ten countries The Hacker News checked today. The flaw is an out-of-bounds read that could let an attacker run code over a network.
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/microsoft-paint-rce-fix-now-available.html

🚨 CVE-2026-115740 - Windows Server
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Windows Server
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 4.3
Resumo:
Server side request forgery vulnerability exists in the DLP on-prem extensions version 11.13.1 and earlier allows the file Prefix parameter in the OpenEventEvidenceFile.do endpoint accepts arbitrary UNC paths without validation. The server-side code attempts to open the specified file path, causing Windows to resolve the hostname and initiate SMB authentication to the attacker-controlled host.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-115740
 
🚨 CVE-2025-15701 - WordPress
 
Criticidade: Baixa
Ferramenta: WordPress
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 3.5
Resumo:
The Easy Social Icons WordPress plugin before 4.0.3 does not sanitise and escape some of its settings before outputting them on front-end pages, which could allow high-privilege users such as Administrators to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks when the unfiltered_html capability is disallowed, for example on a multisite network.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-15701
